english:
Ability Kills spawn 3 Orbs of Power while your Super Energy is between 60% and 99%.

Each Orb of Power grants 7.15% Super Energy.

Spawning Orbs has a 30 second cooldown.

Also works in a Roaming Super as long as your Super Energy is above 60%.

source.text:
While Super Energy is between 60%–99%:

Ability Kills spawn 3 Orbs of Power.
Orbs of Power grant 7.15% Super Energy each.
Incurs a 30 second cooldown between spawning orbs.

Works while in a Roaming Super as long as Super Energy is above 60%.
